blocks.html: Lead Scoring is the process of assigning values or points to leads based on their demographics, behavior, and level of engagement. It helps sales and marketing teams prioritize prospects by identifying which leads are most likely to convert into customers.

Lead Scoring enables businesses to rank leads according to their sales readiness and potential value. Instead of following up with every lead equally, teams can focus on the highest-priority prospects first. Scoring models are commonly used in B2B sales and marketing to improve efficiency, increase conversions, and strengthen alignment between marketing and sales teams.
Leads receive scores based on criteria such as:

items.title: Demographics/Firmographics
items.html: Job title, industry, company size, location, revenue

items.title: Behavioral Signals
items.html: Website visits, pricing page views, content downloads

items.title: Engagement Activity
items.html: Email opens, clicks, webinar attendance, demo requests

items.title: Buying Intent
items.html: Research activity or repeated interest in relevant topics

blocks.html: Scores are updated automatically or manually, and leads that reach a defined threshold are routed to sales for follow-up.
Improves sales productivity and response time
Reduces wasted effort on low-quality leads
Aligns marketing and sales qualification standards

A prospect receives points for being a director-level contact at a target company, visiting the pricing page twice, and requesting a demo. Once the score exceeds the threshold, the lead is assigned to a sales representative.

Lead Scoring is a powerful method for identifying the most valuable opportunities in the pipeline. By ranking leads based on fit and engagement, businesses can focus on the right prospects and accelerate revenue growth.
Prioritize leads that matter most. MarketJoy helps businesses build smarter lead scoring systems that improve conversions, streamline follow-up, and drive stronger pipeline performance.
